name: Lamplight
author: nixfred
description: Drives a Govee lamp from the desktop over the local network. The lamp always wears the active Omarchy theme — there is no colour picker by design — and chooses only what it is DOING: resting on the theme, drifting its palette, following the sun, showing the weather, flashing on events, reacting to music, or acting as a meter.

barWidget.description: A lit dot in the lamp's real colour, read back from the lamp itself. Click for modes, brightness and power.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the lamp is asked what colour it is actually showing. Each poll is one UDP round trip on the LAN.

schema.label: Show the mode letter
schema.description: A single letter beside the dot for the running mode. Off leaves just the dot.

schema.label: Glow halo
schema.description: A soft halo around the dot in the lamp's colour. Turn off to save a little GPU.
